# Business Review Deck Checklist (UI)

Use this checklist whenever a ticket includes UI changes and requires business review artifacts.

## Required Inputs

1. Ticket ID and title
2. Accepted business requirements
3. Static React mockup path in frontend/src
4. Figma file or frame location

## Required Deck Images (PNG)

1. Empty/default state
2. Loading/in-progress state
3. Success state
4. Error state

## Review Notes to Include

1. What changed visually from previous flow
2. Why this supports the business objective
3. Open UX questions or decisions needed
4. Accessibility considerations for visible interactions

## Ticket Traceability Update

Before moving ticket status forward, add these links/references:

1. Static mockup code location
2. Figma file/frame reference
3. Deck image export references
4. Date reviewed with business owner
